cues.title: 同一种引力，能解释月球吗？
cues.titleEn: Can one gravity explain the Moon?
cues.caption: 先锁定平方反比的预测，再检查轨道。
cues.captionEn: Lock the inverse-square prediction before checking the orbit.
cues.zh: 苹果落地，月球却一直绕行，真是同一种引力吗？先只用地面自由落体的已知加速度。月球离地心约六十个地球半径；若引力按距离平方减弱，月球处的加速度就应约为地面的三千六百分之一。先把这个预测留下。月球并不是朝地面直直掉落，我们要检查的是：引力能否不断改变它的速度方向。
cues.en: An apple falls, but the Moon keeps orbiting. Could the same gravity explain both? Start with the known acceleration of free fall at the surface. The Moon is about sixty Earth radii away. If gravity weakens with distance squared, acceleration there should be about one thirty-six-hundredth as large. Keep that prediction. The Moon does not drop straight toward Earth: the question is whether gravity can continually turn its velocity.

cues.title: 用距离与周期独立核对
cues.caption: 轨道给出的加速度接近预测，并不完全相等。
cues.captionEn: The orbital estimate is close to the prediction, not exactly equal.
cues.zh: 现在才打开月球距离和公转周期的参考数据，不使用引力常量。把轨道近似为圆，从一周路程和所需时间求速度，再求改变速度方向所需的加速度。结果约为零点零零二七二米每二次方秒，与预测接近，却不完全相等。真实月球轨道不是理想圆，地球也会运动。若另一个物体离地心更远一倍，平方反比模型又预测什么？加速度变为四分之一；月球的原参考数据没有改变。
cues.en: Now reveal the reference distance and orbital period, without using G. Approximate the orbit as circular: distance per revolution gives speed, and the changing direction gives acceleration. The result is about zero point zero zero two seven two metres per second squared: close to our prediction, but not identical. The real orbit is not a perfect circle, and Earth moves too. What if another object were twice as far from Earth’s centre? The model predicts a quarter of the acceleration. The fixed lunar record stays unchanged.

cues.title: 把微弱引力变成光点位移
cues.titleEn: Turn a tiny attraction into a moving spot
cues.caption: 引力使杆扭转，同一转角改变反射光的方向。
cues.captionEn: Attraction twists the rod; the same angle turns the reflected beam.
cues.zh: 两颗小球悬在细丝下，模型只考虑旁边大球的引力吸引，球面没有接触。沿着每一对球的连线看，四组力共同产生转动作用；细丝越扭，反向恢复力矩越大。杆中央的镜子跟着转动。入射光真的碰到镜面，反射方向随镜面转角改变两倍；远处刻度尺上的光点因此移动。我们放大的是刻度尺细节，不是假装小球转过很大的角度。这样的位移，怎样用来求引力常量？
cues.en: Two small spheres hang from a fine fibre. Nearby large spheres attract them without touching. Follow the four pairwise force directions: together they turn the rod, while the twisting fibre supplies an opposing torque. A mirror attached to the rod turns with it. Light reaches the mirror and reflects toward a screen; its direction changes by twice the mirror angle. The ruler detail is enlarged, not the physical rotation. How can this displacement give us the gravitational constant?

cues.title: 先校准，再反求引力
cues.caption: 发表的位移和振动记录给出带不确定度的G。
cues.captionEn: Published displacement and oscillations give G with an uncertainty.
cues.zh: 这里换成现代实验发表的记录，不是卡文迪许的原始读数。大球两种位置对应不同的平衡位置；两者相差一点八七厘米。振动周期与衰减给出细丝恢复作用相对于转动惯量的大小。再把光点位移换成转角，结合球的质量和距离，就能反求G。采用论文的近邻两对恒力矩近似，结果约为六点五，不确定度零点五，再乘十的负十一次方。它不是预先塞进记录的答案。若细丝刚度加倍呢？转角约减半，但重新校准后，求出的引力常量不变。
cues.en: These are published records from a modern experiment, not Cavendish’s original readings. The two attractor positions have different equilibrium spot positions, separated by one point eight seven centimetres. The oscillation period and decay calibrate restoring torque relative to inertia. Convert displacement into angle, then use the measured masses and geometry to infer G. Under the paper’s constant-torque approximation using the two nearest pairs, the result is six point five, plus or minus zero point five, times ten to the minus eleven in SI units. It was not planted in the records. Double the fibre stiffness: the angle roughly halves, but after recalibration the inferred G stays the same.

cues.title: 先看较慢的水平发射
cues.titleEn: Begin with a slower horizontal launch
cues.caption: 引力不断改变速度方向，轨迹最终与地表相交。
cues.captionEn: Gravity continually turns velocity until the trajectory meets the surface.
cues.zh: 想象在没有空气的地球上方水平发射一个物体。速度较小时，它的弯曲轨迹会与地面相交。画面从三百千米高度出发，只是牛顿思想实验的数值版本，并非可以建造的高山大炮。引力始终指向地心，大小随距离改变。
cues.en: Imagine launching horizontally above an airless Earth. At a lower speed, the curved path intersects the surface. This numerical thought experiment starts at three hundred kilometres altitude; it is not a buildable mountain cannon. Gravity always points toward Earth’s centre and varies with distance.

cues.title: 提高横向速度，落下却绕过地球
cues.titleEn: Increase tangential speed and keep falling around Earth
cues.caption: 轨道运动仍是自由落体，引力没有消失。
cues.captionEn: Orbital motion remains free fall; gravity has not disappeared.
cues.zh: 把初速度调到这一高度的圆轨道速度，物体一边落下一边绕过弯曲地表，持续处于自由落体。绿色短线指向地心，表示加速度方向。自由探索可以继续改变速度，看落地、近圆和椭圆路径；轨迹由同一个中心引力模型积分，预览时长有限。
cues.en: Set the speed to the circular-orbit value at this altitude. The object falls while continually missing the curved surface. The short green line indicates acceleration toward the centre. Exploration changes speed between impact, near-circular and elliptical paths, all integrated from central gravity over a finite preview interval.
